/*******************************************************************************
* Instrument: PSI_DMC_style Powder Diffractometer
*
* Rebuilt powder diffractometer instrument following the given specification.
*******************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT PSI_DMC_rebuild(
    lambda = 2.5666,
    R = 0.87,
    R_curve = 0.87,
    string filename = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz",
    D_PHI = 6,
    SHIFT = 0,
    PACK = 0.7,
    Dw = 0.8,
    BARNS = 1,
    SPLITS = 58
)

DECLARE
%{
  double TTM;
  double OMA;
  double RV;
  double angleGuideCurved;
  double alpha;
  double alpha_curve;

  double mono_q;
  double y_mono;
  int    NV;
  double sample_radius;
  double sample_height;
  double can_radius;
  double can_height;
  double can_thick;
  double Qc;
  double R0;
  double Mvalue;
  double W;
  double Qc_curve;
  double R0_curve;
  double Mvalue_curve;
  double W_curve;
  double ldiff;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  mono_q = 1.8734;
  y_mono = 0.025;
  NV = 5;
  sample_radius = 0.008/2;
  sample_height = 0.03;
  can_radius = 0.0083/2;
  can_height = 0.0303;
  can_thick = 0.00015;
  Qc = 0.0217;
  R0 = 0.995;
  Mvalue = 1.9;
  W = 1.0/250.0;
  Qc_curve = 0.0217;
  R0_curve = 0.995;
  Mvalue_curve = 2.1;
  W_curve = 1.0/250.0;
  ldiff = 0.05;

  TTM = 2*asin(mono_q*lambda/(4*PI))*RAD2DEG;
  OMA = TTM/2;
  RV = fabs(2*2.82*sin(DEG2RAD*OMA));

  angleGuideCurved = -2.0*asin(0.4995/2.0/3612)/PI*180;
  alpha = (R0-R)/Qc/(Mvalue-1);
  alpha_curve = (R0_curve-R_curve)/Qc_curve/(Mvalue_curve-1);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT source_arm = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT source = Source_Maxwell_3(
    yheight = 0.156, xwidth = 0.126,
    Lmin = lambda-ldiff/2, Lmax = lambda+ldiff/2,
    dist = 1.725, focus_xw = 0.02, focus_yh = 0.12,
    T1 = 296.16, T2 = 40.68, I1 = 8.5E11, I2 = 5.2E11)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE source_arm
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE source_arm

COMPONENT PSDbefore_guides = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 128, ny = 128, filename = "PSDbefore_guides",
    xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 1.49999) RELATIVE source_arm
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT l_mon_source = L_monitor(
    nL = 101, filename = "lmonsource.dat",
    xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, Lmin = 0, Lmax = 20, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 1e-9) RELATIVE PSDbefore_guides
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT guide1 = Guide(
    w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12, w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12, l = 4.66,
    R0 = R0, Qc = Qc, alpha = alpha, m = 1.8, W = W)
AT (0, 0, 1.50) RELATIVE source_arm
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE source_arm

COMPONENT PSDbefore_curve = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 128, ny = 128, filename = "PSDbefore_curve",
    xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 4.664) RELATIVE guide1
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT guide2 = Bender(
    w = 0.02, h = 0.12, r = 3612, l = 20,
    R0a = R0_curve, Qca = Qc_curve, alphaa = alpha_curve, ma = Mvalue_curve, Wa = W_curve,
    R0i = R0_curve, Qci = Qc_curve, alphai = alpha_curve, mi = 1, Wi = W_curve,
    R0s = R0_curve, Qcs = Qc_curve, alphas = alpha_curve, ms = Mvalue_curve, Ws = W_curve)
AT (0, 0, 4.69) RELATIVE guide1
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSDafter_curve = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 128, ny = 128, filename = "PSDafter_curve",
    xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 20.0001) RELATIVE guide2
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT bunker = Guide(
    w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12, w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12, l = 3.43,
    R0 = R0, Qc = Qc, alpha = alpha, m = 1.6, W = W)
AT (0, 0, 20.1502) RELATIVE guide2
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE guide2

COMPONENT guide3 = Guide(
    w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12, w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12, l = 12.275,
    R0 = R0, Qc = Qc, alpha = alpha, m = 1.6, W = W)
AT (0, 0, 3.56) RELATIVE bunker
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE bunker

COMPONENT guide4 = Guide(
    w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12, w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12, l = 5.66,
    R0 = R0, Qc = Qc, alpha = alpha, m = 1.6, W = W)
AT (0, 0, 15.8555) RELATIVE bunker
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE guide3

COMPONENT window1 = Al_window(thickness = 0.002)
AT (0, 0, 5.66+1e-9) RELATIVE guide4
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT ydist_fluxpos = PSDlin_monitor(
    nbins = 11, filename = "ydist_fluxpos.dat",
    xwidth = 0.120, yheight = 0.02, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 5.66+1e-8+0.01) RELATIVE guide4
ROTATED (0, 0, 90) RELATIVE window1

COMPONENT PSD_fluxpos = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 100, ny = 100, filename = "xdist_fluxposy.dat",
    xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 5.66+1e-7+0.01) RELATIVE guide4
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT xdist_flux_pos = PSDlin_monitor(
    nbins = 11, filename = "xdist_fluxpos.dat",
    xwidth = 0.020, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 1e-9) RELATIVE PSD_fluxpos
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT PSD_fluxposB = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 100, ny = 100, filename = "PSD_fluxposB.dat",
    xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 6.24-1e-7-0.01) RELATIVE guide4
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT window2 = Al_window(thickness = 0.002)
AT (0, 0, 1e-9) RELATIVE PSD_fluxposB
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT in_slit = Slit(
    xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0, 0, 0.0021) RELATIVE window2
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT lambda_in = L_monitor(
    nL = 128, filename = "L_in.dat",
    xmin = -0.011, xmax = 0.011, ymin = -0.061, ymax = 0.061,
    Lmin = 0, Lmax = 2*lambda, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0.001) RELATIVE in_slit
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT sma = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0.65) RELATIVE in_slit
ROTATED (0, OMA, 0) RELATIVE in_slit

SPLIT SPLITS COMPONENT foc_mono = Monochromator_2foc(
    zwidth = 0.05, yheight = 0.025, gap = 0.0005, NH = 1, NV = 5,
    mosaich = 38, mosaicv = 38, r0 = 0.7, Q = mono_q, RV = RV, RH = 0)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sma
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT msa = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sma
ROTATED (0, TTM, 0) RELATIVE in_slit

COMPONENT out1_slit = Slit(
    xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0, 0, 0.2) RELATIVE msa
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT Amoin_slit = Slit(
    xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0, 0, 0.325) RELATIVE msa
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT Bmoin_slit = Slit(
    xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0, 0, 0.525) RELATIVE msa
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT out2_slit = Slit(
    xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01, ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0, 0, 0.65) RELATIVE msa
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT PSD_sample = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 80, ny = 80, filename = "PSD_sample.dat",
    xmin = -0.05, xmax = 0.05, ymin = -0.07, ymax = 0.07, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 2.77) RELATIVE msa
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT lambda_sample = L_monitor(
    nL = 128, filename = "L_sample.dat",
    xmin = -sample_radius, xmax = sample_radius,
    ymin = -sample_height/2, ymax = sample_height/2,
    Lmin = lambda-0.2, Lmax = lambda+0.2, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 2.81) RELATIVE msa
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT sa_arm = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 2.82) RELATIVE msa
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT sample = PowderN(
    reflections = filename, radius = sample_radius, yheight = sample_height,
    pack = PACK, p_inc = 0, p_transmit = 0, DW = Dw, d_phi = D_PHI, barns = BARNS)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sa_arm
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT STOP = Beamstop(radius = 0.3)
AT (0, 0, 1.4) RELATIVE sa_arm
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sa_arm

COMPONENT Detector = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 3.0, yheight = 0.09, bins = 400,
    min = 19.9+SHIFT, max = 99.9+SHIFT,
    options = "banana,theta", filename = "detector.dat")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE sa_arm
ROTATED (0, 0, 180) RELATIVE sa_arm

END
